question: Two circles with centers B and D have radii DA = 8 cm and BC = x cm, respectively. AC is tangent to both circles. If DB and AC intersect the point E, AE = 12 cm and EC = 18 cm, then find the value of x (in cm).
solution:
Given:

Radius of circle with center D (r) = 8 cm

AE = 12 cm; EC = 18 cm

Concept used:

The tangent makes a right angle with the radius of a circle at the point of contact.

The vertical opposite angle is equal.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5793d803aa164ec1674f965ad863a5e1b60170a48549149bd3e5869dfd9636df.png] 

AD ⊥ AC and BC ⊥ AC

∠DAE = ∠BCE = 90°

In △DAE and △BCE

∠DAE = ∠BCE = 90°

∠AED = ∠BEC (Vertical angle)

△DAE ∼ △BCE (By AA similarity)

By C.P.C.T

⇒ AE/EC = AD/BC

⇒ 12/18 = 8/BC

⇒ BC = 144/12 = 12 cm

∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.
